title: AI Release Quality Gate
text: A production AI feature may ship broadly only when task success is at least 0.90, critical-error rate is at most 0.02, and the golden-set regression rate is at most 0.03. Missing critical metrics fail closed.

title: Responsible AI Release Gate
text: Broad release requires Responsible AI review status PASS. Any BLOCKED or MISSING review requires HOLD. CONDITIONAL review may proceed only as a limited rollout with documented mitigation.

title: Incident Gate
text: An open severity-1 or severity-2 incident affecting the feature requires HOLD. Severity-3 incidents may proceed only when a tested workaround and rollback path exist.

title: Rollout Policy
text: A feature that passes quality and Responsible AI gates but has unresolved medium-risk concerns should begin with a limited rollout of no more than 10 percent before broad expansion.

title: Runtime Observability
text: Production AI releases require owner, rollback plan, runtime monitoring, and alert thresholds. Missing rollback or monitoring readiness requires HOLD.
